purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche Q benchmark authored only after r27 production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded; it was not used to construct r27.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after production verification of r27 and was not used to construct r27.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N/O/P player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: clemency: they choose grave->discard for my +1 influence OR leave it for +1 card?
expectedSourceGroups: Move it to their Discard Pile; +1 Influence

cases.question: demilitarized zone after accepted terms: both withdraw and nobody can enter there rest of turn?
expectedSourceGroups: Neither player may enter there this turn

cases.question: detente only first already-ratified proposal acceptance each turn gives +1 influence?
expectedSourceGroups: already ratified when you offered it, +1 Influence

cases.question: foreclosure: next enemy territory, deed mine + unoccupied = front line +1 in denouement?
expectedSourceGroups: Deed is yours and it is unoccupied

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, if it is the next opposing Territory immediately beyond your Front Line.

cases.question: war bonds after first battle: hand card to treasury, +1 capital?
expectedSourceGroups: After the first battle each turn
place one card from your Hand face up in your Treasury

cases.question: disinformation gambit comes back to hand in aftermath instead of grave?
expectedSourceGroups: return this card to your Hand instead of putting it in your Graveyard

cases.question: encampment end turn while i still occupy and control it = +1 command?
expectedSourceGroups: At the end of this card's owner's turn
occupy and control this Territory, +1 Command

cases.question: shock and awe consolidate = front line +1 and command set to 2?
expectedSourceGroups: Advance Front Line 1, if able; Command = 2

cases.question: rearguard stops their card entering my position and sends that card back to their hand?
expectedSourceGroups: return any card used to its owner's Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, and that card cannot be used again that turn.

cases.question: witchcraft banked: hand card to grave to repeat another battle effect after tactics reveal?
expectedSourceGroups: put 1 card from your Hand in your Graveyard
repeat one other Gambit or Tactic effect you control in this battle

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, once per turn and only if the repeated effect can apply then.

cases.question: sequestration action: each player keeps one asset and discards rest?
expectedSourceGroups: Each player keeps 1 Asset, if able, and discards the rest

cases.question: strategic withdrawal in denouement after movement ended starts a new 1-position movement sequence?
expectedSourceGroups: begin a new Movement sequence with up to one Position of movement

cases.question: plenipotentiary ratifies after refusal: refused effect still happens and no influence for that ratification?
expectedSourceGroups: Gain no Influence for ratifying it this way. Its Refused effect still applies

cases.question: sequestration forces contingency plan out, so its Removed trigger gives +1 card?
expectedSourceGroups: If this card is Removed, +1 Card

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The forced discard counts as Removal, so Contingency Plan gives +1 Card.
